info: To book a ticket on TickXplore, go to the 'Vehicle Tickets' or 'Tourist Booking' section, select your destination, choose your preferred vehicle or entry option, select date and seats (if applicable), and complete the booking using Khalti or Cash on Visit.

Visit the 'Vehicle Tickets' section on TickXplore, select a vehicle such as a jeep, 4x4, or Scorpio, pick your dates, enter your pickup and drop-off locations, and proceed to payment to reserve the vehicle.
Go to your dashboard and open 'Booking History'. For upcoming bookings, you can request a refund by providing a reason. The admin will review and notify you via email once approved.
Log in to TickXplore and open your dashboard. The 'Booking History' section displays all past and upcoming bookings along with their status, price, and refund details.

location: How to register as a vendor?
info: Go to the vendor registration page on TickXplore, fill in your business and vehicle details, upload required documents, and submit the form. Admins will verify and activate your account before you can start managing bookings.

location: How does Cash on Visit work?
info: When booking a vehicle or seat on TickXplore, you can choose 'Cash on Visit' as a payment method. Your booking is reserved and you pay the vendor directly at the time of travel.
TickXplore supports payments through Khalti for online transactions and also offers Cash on Visit (CoV) for in-person payments.
